The 25 two-eye contours, 39 state pools/cadence, 10 colors and 8 shape paths in data.json are transformed from original-data.js and customizer.js. Rendering, lifecycle, role integration and device export are adapted for TinyBot. Upstream social sharing UI is replaced by TinyBot export actions; no external post is sent automatically.
